# AntiConjugate

> Abstaining ADC prescribing-risk research prototype. Confidence and guardrail scores are not clinically calibrated; pharmacist review and fresh hidden validation are required.

- [Full Documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete clinical, architectural, and benchmark specifications.
- [Agent package](adcg/): rules + ADCdb/FDA/SOP/HPA lookup + LLM drafting + abstention + guardrail: LawZero generator + neutral estimator implementation.
- [Curated ADCdb Table](data/adcdb_curated_table.json): Draft clinical & biophysical dataset, requiring verification.
- [Benchmark inputs](benchmark/test/items_public.json): 30 items, inputs only (gold answers are kept private by the test owner).
- [TruthRL Scorer](scorer.py): Brier measurement, must-flag checks, loaded-KB citation validation and live API identifier checks; not proof of claim entailment.
- [Core Package](adcg/): Modular Python package (`adcg.agent`, `adcg.guardrail`, `adcg.rules`, `adcg.score`, `adcg.kb`).
- [Development Results](results/RESULTS_dev.md): Score breakdowns and performance comparisons against plain LLMs.
- [30-item results (real LLM)](results/RESULTS_30item.md)
- [Mock-up only, not results](data/mock_illustrative/README.md): from the removed `agent_guardrail.py` (no LLM)
